thread:
liam: Heads-up 10; power blip knocked modem and my desk plant (RIP) but router came back. Was on mobile hotspot for 40 mins. Anyone got good battery-backed router or UPS recs? :sweat_smile:

anya: Oof. I use APC BE600M1 10; keeps router + modem + phone charger for ~2 hrs.

carlos: I have a cheap UPS that handles my desktop and router for an hour. Also pro tip: take a photo of modem lights when filing ISP ticket.

marta: Plant survived? :seedling:

liam: Plant resurrected after emergency watering. But lost all my in-progress tabs. :sob:

bot-elle: FYI: #random trending topics: 'UPS', 'hotspot', 'plant rescue'. :robot_face:

anya: If hotspot: enable "low data mode" on laptop and tether only, or use USB tether rather than phone hotspot for stability.

carlos: Poll: do you keep a portable battery for networking? React: :one: yes, :two: nope, :three: only for phone

marta: :two:

liam: :one: 10; bought a 20,000mAh power bank with AC outlet.

anya: Also found a cute tiny router (GL.iNet) that runs off USB powerbanks. Handy for travel.

liam: Link? would love that for future outages.

anya: https://example.com/glinet-mini 10; works with OpenWrt images.

carlos: small checklist for outages: 1) phone charged 2) tether cable 3) router powerbank 4) "I'm on hotspot" slack status.

marta: adding "photo of plant" to checklist. :camera_with_flash:

liam: Thanks team 10; packing a UPS into my weekend shopping list. Also attaching the modem shrine pic (later) :camera:

bot-elle: Reminder scheduled: "Check UPS compatibility with ISP modem" in #random tomorrow at 09:00. :bell:
